Standard: Long-term longitudinal time responses with a period of 15 seconds or longer has a positive damping ratio, unless pilot evaluation determines the air vehicle handling qualities are no worse than Level 2. There are no unstable aperiodic modes. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the air vehicle's long-term longitudinal dynamics as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Phugoid Dynamics paragraph and Long-Term Longitudinal Response paragraph, for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the air vehicle's long-term longitudinal dynamics as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Phugoid Dynamics paragraph and Long- Term Longitudinal Response paragraph, for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the air vehicle's long-term longitudinal dynamics as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Phugoid Dynamics paragraph and Long-Term Longitudinal Response paragraph, for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
